findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1090-1124 labels §8.1 as the deterministic executable-code table but omits PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED. The real read-only observe path returns {status:fail, blocking:false, codes:[PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED]} when pre-review-check.json is absent, as reproduced with `node bin/lattice.js pre_review_check_read {storyId:B-4ec1,json:true}` and implemented at packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:181-186. Add the stable code and its missing/invalid/signature/binding condition so the authoritative plan explains the actual observe diagnostic.

packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts:145-161 / :187-198 — VI-W3-M1-EVERY-BINDING-TAMPER and VI-W3-M4-STABLE-GATE-CODES lack an end-to-end lifecycle-consumer assertion for artifact tamper. The table mutates every binding and proves only pre_review_check_read reports PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED; runPreReviewCheckGate is exercised only for a clean PASS and an enforce failure caused by PR_TOPOLOGY_CRITIC_REATTESTATION_REQUIRED. Therefore the focused smoke can pass even if the actual DEV→REVIEW consumer drops, masks, or fails to block PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED. Add an enforce-mode case with critic precondition satisfied, persist one tampered signed artifact, invoke the real transition gate/entrypoint, assert blocking output contains PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED and no phase/partial metadata write occurs, then restore/reissue exactly and assert the same transition path immediately passes.

packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:180-185 missing artifact is misclassified as cryptographic/content tampering: verifyPreReviewCheckArtifact returns PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED when artifact is null. The live B-4ec1 DEV-to-REVIEW run had no .lattice/story/actives/B-4ec1/pre-review-check.json and emitted mode=observe status=fail code=PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED, so production audit output cannot distinguish an unrun producer from an altered signed artifact, and the real transition did not prove the promised self-hosted PASS path. Observe being non-blocking is expected rollout behavior but does not make the false failure classification or absent live artifact acceptable. Add a deterministic missing-artifact result/remediation and a live production DEV-to-REVIEW assertion that persists and consumes the verifier-owned artifact; retain PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED only for invalid stored artifacts.

doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1090-1124 omits PR_TOPOLOGY_CRITIC_REATTESTATION_REQUIRED from its deterministic code table even though packages/main/src/core/pre-review-check.ts:153 emits it whenever enforce mode lacks a current independent critic and the lifecycle remediation explicitly promises that stable blocking reason. Add this separate enforce-only condition so §8.1, §8.2 and the actual gate vocabulary agree.
